Due to the increasing number of duty-related inquiries and frequent tariff changes, our response time may be slightly delayed. Please rest assured that we are processing all requests in the order they are received and will respond as soon as possible.

Please note that inquiries involving regulatory interpretation or prospective compliance matters (such as free trade agreements, AD/CVD inquires, labeling, or other compliance determinations) may be best addressed by a qualified trade attorney or customs compliance consultant. We would be happy to assist with entry processing and implementation once formal guidance is available.

We appreciate your understanding and will do our best to assist you promptly.

Best regards,

subject: Re: Bond lead time before first entry
body:
We do not offer single-entry bonds, only continuous. Our program is 
designed for professional importers that engage in receiving incoming 
goods regularly. You may learn more about the various CBP bond 
obligations at https://Customs-Bonds.com  We have attached a helpful 
guide to the application requirements as well. In order to quote you we 
will need the following, . . .

  * Customs bond application and release (attached).
  * Current personal financial statement of owner(s). (You may use the
    attached template if you wish.)
  * Business financial statement, current balance sheet and year-to-date
    P&L.
  * Any correspondence between the applicant and CBP regarding
    regulation of the importer’s/exporter’s business.
  * Please indicate if any of the goods being imported are subject to
    antidumping or prevailing/counterprevailing duties.


Because of the nature of these bonds, we must accomplish a review of the 
applicant’s credit and financial statement in order to properly quote 
premium. I will do so and respond to you immediately. We look forward to 
helping you!


*_Please give us a “Like” on Facebook. Go to 
https://www.facebook.com/Surety1  or on your mobile telephone text ‘like 
surety1' to 32665 or on ‘X’ at https://x.com/suretyone._*
